chunks: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked him, 'Did the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) enter into Ihram at night or during the day?' So he said, 'During the day.' I said, 'At what time?' He said, 'At the Dhuhr prayer.' So I asked him, 'When do you think we should enter into Ihram?' He said, 'It is the same upon you. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) entered into Ihram at the Dhuhr prayer because the water was scarce, as if it were at the tops of the mountains, so a man would leave to acquire that from the morning, and they could hardly manage to find the water. And these waters are newly occurring.'

key_terms.أَحْرَمَ: Entered into the state of Ihram for Hajj or Umrah

ai.seo_question: When did the Prophet Muhammad enter Ihram and does this time restriction apply to all Muslims?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that the Prophet’s entry into Ihram at Dhuhr was a pragmatic response to water scarcity at Mina, rather than a fixed ritual requirement, thereby establishing flexibility for the Ummah. This hadith is pivotal in Shia jurisprudence for distinguishing between the Sunnah of the Prophet (which may be contextual) and obligatory acts, reinforcing the principle that Ihram timing is not strictly bound to a specific hour unless necessitated by circumstances.

en.hubeali:
Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad Bin usman, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said,

‘I asked himasws, ‘Did Rasool-Allahsaww wear Ihraam at night or at daytime?’ So heasws said: ‘At daytime’. I said, ‘At what time?’ Heasws said: ‘Al-Zohr Prayer’. So I asked himasws, ‘When do youasws view we should be wearing Ihraam?’ So heasws said: ‘It is the same upon you. But rather, Rasool-Allahsaww wore Ihraam at Al-Zohr Prayer because the water was scarce. It used to occur in the top parts of the mountains, so the man would leave to acquire that from the morning, and almost was not able upon finding the water, and rather, these waters (today), are newly occurring’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad ibn ‘Uthaman from al-Halabiy who has said the following:

“I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about Ihram of the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, if it was during the day or night. He (the Imam) said, ‘It was during the day.’ I then asked at what time of the day was it?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘It was at al-Zuhr.’ I then asked, ‘When should we do so?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘It is all the same for you. The Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, did so because water was scarce. It was only on mountains and a man had to move for it one day earlier and he would almost not find any. These waters are found only recently.”’
